description:
Optional identity in a pattern's existing header. The host owns the avatar's
state and animation; these slots never submit, decide, or announce anything.

actions.description: Identity controls, such as a color picker, inside the same header.

avatar.description: A decorative avatar, replacing the default AI mark.

color.description: Identity color, tinting the existing tray without recoloring its paper.

name.description: The agent's name, where the pattern shows assistant attribution.
